verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury offers a high-yield Investment Account (up to 4.46% APY) alongside a Checking Account, described as 'professionally managed and fully automated,' and separately documents 'target balance automation' and auto top-up between linked checking accounts, which together support building an automated cash cushion. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly show a unified 'sub-account with automated transfer rules' flow (e.g., configurable sweep triggers moving idle cash into the yield account) — the target-balance automation described is tied to card funding top-ups rather than the yield/investment account itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable transfer rules/sweeps between checking and the high-yield Investment Account, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this automation working as described.
